hints.title: Build in order
hints.body: Keep combinations nondecreasing so the same multiset is never generated twice.

hints.title: Choose or move on
hints.body: At each step, either take the current candidate again or move to a later candidate.

hints.title: Prune with sorted values
hints.body: If a candidate exceeds the remaining target, every later candidate is also too large.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort candidates
backtrack(start, remaining, path):
    if remaining == 0: record path; return
    for i from start to end:
        if candidates[i] > remaining: break
        append candidates[i]
        backtrack(i, remaining - candidates[i], path)
        remove last value
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
